name: Lakewood
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Lakewood, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Lakewood, Ohio for 2026: Light Up Lakewood on Detroit Avenue, with dates and details checked on the host site.
lede: Lakewood kicks off its holiday season with Light Up Lakewood, a free downtown celebration on Detroit Avenue.
celebrates: Lakewood celebrates Christmas in the heart of its Downtown district. LakewoodAlive presents Light Up Lakewood, which the City of Lakewood calls one of Northeast Ohio's most beloved holiday traditions, with live entertainment, local shopping and family activities along Detroit Avenue. The event page lists a parade, a stage, a holiday hayrack ride, a Family Fun Zone, ice carving and hot chocolate, and the Lakewood Public Library is among its sponsors. The event is free and needs no registration.
lastyear: Light Up Lakewood also ran last winter. A LakewoodAlive page for the 2025 celebration and a Lakewood Public Library post both pointed to Saturday, December 6, 2025, with the library welcoming Santa in person for a visit, a holiday craft for kids and a sensory calming space as part of the evening. For 2026 the celebration moves to Saturday, December 5, from 4 to 8 pm.
facts: LakewoodAlive, the nonprofit that presents Light Up Lakewood, describes it as typically held on the first Saturday in December. The 2026 event is on that first Saturday, December 5, and runs along Detroit Avenue between Arthur and Marlowe Avenues, according to the City of Lakewood.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Lakewood itself. Families here often head to the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad, which runs holiday trains from Northeast Ohio stations, and the RTA Rapid and HealthLine connect Cleveland neighborhoods. Amtrak's Lake Shore Limited stops at Cleveland Lakefront Station. Check each operator for 2026 schedules before you plan a trip.
train_links: Scenic and holiday train rides through Cuyahoga Valley National Park.
traditions: A free downtown celebration with a parade, a lighting ceremony and family activities.
A holiday hayrack ride is part of the Light Up Lakewood lineup.
Ice carvers work along Detroit Avenue during the celebration.
Lakewood Public Library welcomed Santa during the 2025 celebration.
kidfact: Light Up Lakewood always lands on the first Saturday in December, so Lakewood kids know exactly when the holiday season begins.
faq: Lakewood's main holiday tradition is Light Up Lakewood, a free celebration along Detroit Avenue in Downtown Lakewood with live entertainment, local shopping and family activities. LakewoodAlive presents it each December, and the City of Lakewood lists it on its events calendar.
Is there a free Christmas event in Lakewood?
Yes. Light Up Lakewood on December 5, 2026 is free to attend and needs no registration, according to LakewoodAlive.
When is Light Up Lakewood in 2026?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 4 to 8 pm along Detroit Avenue between Arthur and Marlowe Avenues.
Is there a Christmas train ride in Lakewood?
We did not find one in Lakewood. The Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs holiday trains elsewhere in Northeast Ohio, so check its schedule.
